items.reason: An unbound set using --task-runtime-path can acquire a binding during setup while its header still reports “unbound binding”.
Whole-set CLI routing always supplies placement, including runs inside the bound checkout.
InvokedFrom uses the resolved project root rather than cwd, losing subdirectories and misreporting invocations with project/path overrides.
BoundDefault triggers the “binding recorded to current checkout” announcement.
The previous conditional bound-checkout message is removed.
Single-task AFK execution prints the current-checkout line without a Drain header.
The current-checkout line prints before the single-task HITL branch.
Successful whole-set task execution prints one green done result.
Commit SHA or verified-no-op detail follows the green result line.
The old completion printer is removed, with one result printer per ending.
Exhausted retries that fail the task produce one red failed result.
Provider exhaustion preserves the open state and prints the distinct red left-open result.
Quota parking prints a yellow quota-paused result naming the selected preset.
Interrupted execution maps to the yellow interrupted result.
Blocked and Deferred handling adds no Task result lines; executed tasks retain their results.
Attempt failure narration, timing breakdowns, and exhausted-walk narration remain.
Both new output helpers preserve complete lines and suppress ANSI for redirected output.
Task results use existing terminal color detection and NO_COLOR handling.
The added reporting writes only output and introduces no journal rows.

scores.rationale: Clear helpers and focused tests cover most behavior, but invocation-directory handling and binding metadata after setup remain incorrect.
